title: feat(showcase): SDUI big-screen "Command Center" 大屏 page (+ objectui bump)
body:
Adds a full-bleed, **theme-following** "交付运营数据大屏 / Delivery Operations Command Center" page to the showcase — a worked example that an SDUI micro-page can compose a real data-screen / 大屏.

- **KPI hero strip** (6 metrics) + **gradient** bar/area charts + a **container-scaled donut** + a live **work-queue grid**.
- **Theme-adaptive**: clean light dashboard in a light console; one cohesive dark 大屏 when the console is switched to dark (no dark-island mismatch).
- Cohesive chart palette via a per-page `--chart-1..5` override.
- Nav: Analytics → Command Center (大屏).

### Depends on objectstack-ai/objectui#1922
Bumps `.objectui-sha` → `c9a3fc8db` for the three renderer capabilities the page relies on (full-bleed `width:'full'` pages, container-scaled donuts, gradient fills). **Merge objectui#1922 first.**
